tradeoff_notes: Tighter 512MB RAM requires smaller YOLO input or swap
Lower dynamic range at night; adequate for 320x240 LSPIV
Wider beam cone & temperature drift vs narrow ToF laser
No Wi-Fi/BLE fallback; requires 3.3V logic level shifter
Lower write endurance over multi-month continuous video
